scope:
Local tuning experiments, not a cabin SPL predictor or production preset.

grid: nine retention/rear combinations; bass: trims/LFE around a chosen grid
point; stress: explicit common EQ and arbitrary B-boundary stress signals;
match: post-guard, front-mid-power-matched6ch comparison files with full-clip
v7 sample-peak margin. No vehicle I/O, no automatic production selection.

warnings: complex block 0xC4D17 modelled as identity (omits conditional 1023-sample delay and adaptive five-band processing)
upstream processing before input matrix C4AED not numerically emulated
first mixer B audio assumed zero unless injected; stored B dB=[0, 0, -100, -100, 0, 0, 0, 0, -99, -99]
second mixer B audio assumed zero unless injected; nonzero B gains exist
C4B59/C4DDA gains and C4E9A/C4ED3 limiters omitted: runtime not supplied
static profile/row, ASAD FC, normal selectors; no live MMI state, tone/volume or acoustics
input-bus EQ packed grouping inferred; physical output names are candidates
row EQ supported only for verified unity; post EQ binding decoded; float64, not SHARC bit equivalence

analysis.reference: dry L/R-only PCM6 BANK1, not stock stereo
analysis.alignment: per-output known A-path delay plus upmix latency
analysis.power: Welch 32768/50%; linear mean within groups; mean paired dB across tracks
analysis.peaks: model sample peaks relative to input full scale, not hardware overload verdict
analysis.render_mode: existing WAVs; variant settings are labels

whole_clip.scope: whole rendered clip; sample peaks, NOT true peaks or physical overload
